rationale.conceptual: The task involves an established but non-trivial method: DFT supercell defect calculations with geometry relaxation, band structure, and careful reference alignment. It requires understanding of defect formation, supercell construction, and DOS interpretation, going beyond a textbook one-liner, but does not demand a novel algorithm or deep new theory.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has multiple stages (pristine calculation, two defect complexes, energy comparison) with dependencies (perfect-cell band edges needed for alignment). It requires selecting pseudopotentials, converging parameters, and post-processing DOS data. This is a typical multi-stage DFT workflow but not overly long or fragile; a competent user can script the runs.
